strings.locale.help:
# Locale Setup

* **Language**: The language of the appliance.

* **Timezone Region**: The timezone region of the appliance.

* **Timezone City**: The timezone city of the appliance.
strings.features.help:
# Appliance Features

* **Wifi Hotspot**: When running on compatible hardware, a WiFi hotspot will allow to use the appliance as a WiFi access point.

* **MulticastDNS**: When enabled, the appliance will broadcast its address on local network.
strings.features.wifihotspot.warning: Note: WiFi Hotspot is not available on %s medium.
strings.taoce.help:
# TAO Community Edition Configuration

* **Domain Name**: The fully qualified domain name of the appliance.

* **Flavor**: The flavor of the appliance.
strings.taoce.flavor.full.description: Full flavor includes all features and services.
strings.taoce.flavor.essential.description: Full version without Grader and Proctor services.
strings.wifihotspot.help:
# WiFi Hotspot Setup

* **SSID**: WiFi hotspot SSID.

* **Security**: WiFi hotspot security.

* **Password**: WiFi hotspot password.
strings.done.confirm.title: Do you want to restart configuration?
strings.error.taoce.fqdn.invalid: Domain name must be a valid FQDN.
strings.error.taoce.fqdn.not_local: When using MulticastDNS, the domain name must end with ".local".
strings.error.wifihotspot.password.required: WiFi hotspot password is required when security is enabled.
strings.error.wifihotspot.ssid.invalid: WiFi hotspot SSID must be between 1 and 32 ASCII characters.
strings.error.wifihotspot.password.invalid: WiFi hotspot password must be between 1 and 32 ASCII characters.
